name: Handle Invoice Push to QBO
purpose: Pushes one Karbon invoice (parameter FmId) to QuickBooks Online: makes sure the customer and every invoice-line item already have a QBO id (sending missing ones through LedgerLink, and creating an ExternalLink record for a new customer), converts the invoice (415), sends it to QBO, and on success stores the QBO id, document number and line numbers/ids back on the invoice and clears the qbo_send flag. If QBO refuses the send and the invoice status is "Edit", sets status to "Need to Send".

name: Convert Karbon Invoice into QBO Invoice
purpose: Builds the QBO invoice JSON for one Karbon invoice (parameter: SalesTransaction id): reads the latest QBO copy when the invoice already has a qbo_id (via LedgerLink Read) and drops its MetaData, sparse, domain and Line parts, maps 27 invoice fields (dates, bill and ship addresses, memo, totals, tracking number, email) to QBO names, converts the customer and term ids to QBO ids (script 327), converts each sales line (416), adds a shipping line (item SHIPPING_ITEM_ID, tax code NON) when shipAmt is above 0 and sets EmailStatus to NeedToSend when a bill email exists. Returns the QBO invoice JSON.

name: List of Invoice FMIds to Send
purpose: Returns the list of ids of all invoices whose qbo_send flag is 1, i.e. the invoices waiting to be sent to QuickBooks Online. The comment says it supports an override for the Send Invoices run.
